title: Letters
drDigitalIntro:
Welcome to the keyboard. The letter keys are where most of it happens.
• The letter keys type words, sentences, and messages.
• They work just like a classic typewriter.

playgroundTask.instructions: Give the letter keys a try. Type the words below — don't worry about capital letters, just the letters and spaces.

drDigitalSuccess: You typed it. Those 26 keys are most of everything you will ever write.
drDigitalHint: Type exactly: hello dr digital — just lowercase letters and spaces, nothing else.
